issues.description: Native topic silently replaces an explicit OpenSpec target; imported topic linked to another change runs sync against that other source (AGR-105 violation).
issues.recommendation: Reject native or source-mismatched collisions with exit 1; validate openspec_source against change_dir before sync and request --as.

issues.description: Explicit and bare-ID paths accept symlinked/arbitrary change dirs; pwd -P hides symlink and allows escape from project openspec/changes/.
issues.recommendation: Reject symlink components, archives, canonical paths outside project openspec/changes/; require exactly one id segment.

issues.description: End-of-run export omits --mb <bank>; explicit/global banks use CWD .memory-bank so dry-run may inspect the wrong topic.
issues.recommendation: Pass resolved bank to both dry-run and approved --write commands.

issues.description: A sole openspec/changes/<id> dir argument without --mb is taken as the bank path; the test masks this by always passing --mb.
issues.recommendation: Detect OpenSpec change dirs before the directory-as-bank heuristic; add a test without --mb.

issues.description: Staged batch publish wrongly closed: sequential os.replace leaves a partial batch if a later rename fails.
issues.recommendation: Recoverable journal with rollback/roll-forward and stale staged-file cleanup.

issues.description: Bank lock is fail-open: _dir_lock yields False on flock failure but bank_lock proceeds unlocked.
issues.recommendation: Check the yielded result and fail closed.

issues.description: TOCTOU remains: after re-read, a /mb work or manual edit can change requirements.md before line 289 overwrites with stale snapshot; adapter lock not shared with those writers.
issues.recommendation: Shared writer lock or CAS for final requirements/sidecar publish; abort on generation change.

issues.description: export --new has same stale-publication window after the single re-read; creates change then overwrites tasks/sidecar/requirements independently.
issues.recommendation: Stage all files, revalidate immediately before publish under a shared lock, publish transactionally.

issues.description: NEW: staged files get fresh-file permissions and os.replace bypasses mode-preserving publisher; a 0600 bank file can widen to 0644.
issues.recommendation: Copy destination mode to staged file before replace or use the established mode-preserving primitive.
